in_marathi.name: Navdeepraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे New, Deep, God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Navdeepraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Navdeepraj is a Sanskrit name, composed of Nav (new) and Deepraj (God). It is a name that signifies the arrival of a divine and new being into this world.
